newsitem.title: UK: UK physical grain markets lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: UK physical grain markets lower in quiet trade.

text.p: UK physical grain prices saw further small falls on Monday on a very quiet market.
"We can't say the market has dried up because it's never really got going today," said a trader.
On the fob market values were unquoted.
"We have not heard a market, never any business," said a trader.
Delivered traders reported little activity with values around 0.50 stg down.
In East Anglia feed wheat was fetching 97.50 stg a tonne for November while 98 and 97.50 stg was paid for December in the Liverpool area.
Feed barley was trading at 97 stg for November and 98 stg for December in Norfolk/Suffolk.
Milling wheat 11 percent protein fetched 119 stg in the Southampton, Tewkesbury, Avonmouth and Gloucester range for Januray/March.
